format: five-panel drawing from released candidate and mapping records

panels.d: best candidate-experimental relationship classes and examples
panels.e: feasibility classes and novelty review priorities

notes: The PNG is exported at 300 dpi.
Molecular structures are read from the released candidate and experimental-input records.
Structural association arrows denote reviewed candidate-to-reagent relationships; relation classes and selection rationales are retained in the mapping records.
Feasibility classes and novelty priorities organize chemical review and are not reaction-success probabilities.
